runtimeScope: read-only audit of current FlowBundle seed; no app adapter implemented

inventory.evidence: Current implementation, aggregated from lib/flow/seed-flows.ts and FlowBundle types on 2026-07-20.

category.rule: Use an exact alias table only to propose primaryLifeArea and preserve the legacy label as topicTags. Persistence requires immediate-user-outcome evidence; a label match alone is never automatic canonical truth.

category.topicTagRule: Preserve the legacy label as a topicTag after lifeArea mapping; never expose it as a new canonical enum.

automaticOnlyWhen: source or user anchor provenance exists
at least one canonical ScheduleSpec exists
day offset was not synthesized from item order
timeline.currentDecision: proposal_only because runtime day_offset provenance is not trustworthy enough

routine.manualExample: picture-book-reading-routine can be routine or resource queue depending on whether books rotate

priority: decision criteria and terminal choice -> compare_decide
checklist.reason: checklist is a view/artifact and does not identify execution semantics

automaticOnlyWhen: source explicitly defines heterogeneous stage outputs and dependencies

structure_type.sourceShapeRule: No structure_type value can directly determine sourceShape; source rows or a source snapshot are required.

internal_check.reason: A delivery surface does not prove that checklist is the dominant retained artifact. Confirm against the user job and source state.

sheet.automaticOnlyWhen: stable source row schema and FieldDefinitions exist

memo.automaticOnlyWhen: a static retained note completes the user job and stateful Items remain modeled

hybrid.adapterRule: Inspect demonstrated projection profiles, choose the artifact whose loss breaks the job, and put the others in secondaryArtifacts. Never persist hybrid.

missing.forbiddenFallback: Do not infer and persist from structure_type alone.

rules.calendar: Treat as an old schedule/projection hint only; it does not determine intent.
rules.todo: Treat as a generic old execution hint only; it does not determine completion or intent.

item.type.reason: One raw type cannot represent simultaneous schedule, recurrence, record, decision and caution facets.

decisionStates.automatic: Structured source-backed signal exists and no contradictory field exists.
decisionStates.proposal_only: Legacy value suggests a mapping but source provenance or required canonical fields are incomplete.
decisionStates.human_review: Two or more canonical values are plausible or hybrid/missing information hides the primary result.
decisionStates.blocked: Source rows are missing or a sensitive conclusion would exceed evidence.

allThreeLegacyAxes.note: Seventeen bundles have strong three-axis proposals, but category labels do not prove the immediate user outcome; all 153 still need canonical confirmation.

fullTaxonomyV11BackendReady.reason: Current runtime has no first-class SourceRow/sourceShape, access, rights and parallel review contract.

implementationBoundary: This file defines a future compatibility adapter. No runtime type, seed, route, projection or persistence code was changed.
